title: 三个月造的机器人，凭啥不摔？
title_en: Built in 3 Months: Why Doesn't It Fall?

segments.en: Three months

segments.zh: 造出一台一米五的人形机器人。
segments.en: to build a humanoid robot one and a half meters tall.
The builders: Zuckerberg's Meta
and Shanghai's Fourier.
Reportedly it is called Max
and weighs about forty eight kilograms.

segments.zh: 脸是一块屏幕，会做表情，
segments.en: Its face is a screen that makes expressions,
and it has five fingered hands.
Meta's team flew to China,

segments.zh: 一位副总裁在傅利叶的工厂待了快两个月。
segments.en: and a vice president spent almost two months at Fourier's factory.
Today's brain teaser:

segments.zh: 一个两条腿的铁家伙，凭什么站着不摔？
segments.en: how does a two legged machine stand without falling?
The answer may surprise you:
it is falling all the time.
Try a game:

segments.zh: 把一把扫把立在手心上。
segments.en: balance a broom on your palm.
Keep your hand still,
and the broom topples right away.
You have to keep moving your hand,
chasing the way it falls.

segments.zh: 物理学家管这叫倒立摆：
segments.en: Physicists call it an inverted pendulum:
weight on top, pivot at the bottom.
A robot standing on two legs

segments.zh: 就是一把会自己挪手的扫把。
segments.en: is a broom that moves its own hand.
There is one rule:

segments.zh: 重心要落在脚底板围成的那块地方里。
segments.en: the center of mass must stay over the area under its feet.
Once the center of mass leaves that area,
it starts to fall.

segments.zh: 反转一：高一点，反而好平衡。
segments.en: Twist one: taller is easier.

segments.zh: 长扫把比铅笔好立多了。
segments.en: A long broom is easier to balance than a pencil.
Because taller things fall slower,
you get more time to catch them.

segments.zh: 估算一下：一米五的个子，重心大约在腰，
segments.en: A rough estimate: for a one and a half meter body, the center of mass is near the waist.

segments.zh: 不管它的话，一秒左右就躺地上了。
segments.en: Left alone, it hits the floor in about a second.
So a robot must check very fast
whether it is tilting.
It has a gyroscope inside,

segments.zh: 就像你耳朵里管平衡的那个小器官。
segments.en: like the balance organ in your inner ear.
Sensors in the feet
feel where the weight presses.
A typical humanoid robot

segments.zh: 每秒要这样调几百次甚至上千次。
segments.en: adjusts like this hundreds or even thousands of times a second.
Twist two: so the brain must ride
inside the robot itself.
If it had to ask the cloud,

segments.zh: 来回一趟可能就要几十到上百毫秒。
segments.en: one round trip could take tens to hundreds of milliseconds.
By the time the answer came back,
the robot would be lying down.
Max uses Nvidia's Thor chip,
built right into its body.
Walking is even wilder:
every step starts with falling forward.
Then a foot swings out
and catches it.
Walking is falling
and catching yourself, again and again.
You walk this way every day too.
You just forgot.
Twist three: the hardest part is not standing.
It is stairs.

segments.zh: 脚下的地面突然变了高度，
segments.en: The ground suddenly changes height,
and it has to see that coming.
Reportedly, Max 2 started in September,

segments.zh: 加了帮它上楼梯的传感器。
segments.en: with extra sensors to help it on stairs.

segments.zh: 还换了新躯干、更好的手，
segments.en: Plus a new torso, better hands,
and even a projector.

segments.zh: Meta想让它当自家AI Muse的身体，
segments.en: Meta wants it to be a body for its AI, Muse,
and someday help with chores.
Picture it:
AI finally gets legs.
And the first thing it has to learn
is not to fall.
Building it in three months

segments.zh: 也说明中国的机器人供应链多成熟。
segments.en: also shows how mature China's robot supply chain is.

segments.zh: 傅利叶自己也做人形机器人，
segments.en: Fourier makes its own humanoids too,

segments.zh: 比如一米六五高的陪护机器人GR-3。
segments.en: like GR-3, a one hundred sixty five centimeter care robot.

segments.zh: 友情提示：这些都来自媒体报道，
segments.en: Fine print: all of this comes from media reports.

segments.zh: Meta说原型只做内部研究，不卖。
segments.en: Meta says the prototypes are for research, not for sale.
One second to fall, hundreds of checks a second:

segments.zh: 是一般情况的估算，不是Max的官方参数。
segments.en: these are general estimates, not Max's official specs.

segments.zh: 所以，三个月造的机器人，凭啥不摔？
segments.en: So how does a robot built in three months not fall?

segments.zh: 它一刻不停地在摔，又一刻不停地接住自己。
segments.en: It never stops falling, and never stops catching itself.
Just like you.

segments.zh: 只不过它还在学，你已经会了。
segments.en: It is still learning. You already know how.

elements.text: 落在脚底板围成的地方里
